A '''child''' had a [[Plasticene/Legends|plasticene]] [[Doll/Legends|doll]] named [[Branli]], and was looked after by a [[MK 8001 Attendant Droid]] called [[Dooba]]. While playing on a [[grav slide]], the child's doll fell and broke its finger. Taking Branli to Dooba, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] fixed the doll's finger.<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
